study_meta.period_raw: February 5–24, 2020 (quarantine period); cases with onset dates from January 20
study_meta.population_raw: 2,666 passengers and 1,045 crew members (3,711 total) aboard the Diamond Princess cruise ship
study_meta.sample_size_raw: 26 pairs of passenger cases in same cabin; 6 pairs of crew cases in same cabins
study_meta.method_raw: Descriptive and analytical statistics; serial interval computed between cases in same cabin; a series interval of 4 days used to assign secondary/tertiary case status within cabins

parameter_mentions.value_raw: 9 of 26 pairs (35%) had serial interval ≥5 days
